narrative.intro: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals has $279M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Regeneron Pharmaceuticals received 3 awards this fiscal year, producing an average award size of $93.1M. Recent fiscal-year obligations include $5.6B in FY21, $494K in FY22, and $326M in FY23, with $279M recorded in FY26 to date. Large individual awards drive the current-year total rather than many small purchases, and the award count and average award size are the clearest signals of Regeneron Pharmaceuticals’ federal footprint for the period shown. Buyers and competitors should note the concentration of obligations into a small number of awards when assessing Regeneron Pharmaceuticals’ role on government programs this fiscal year.
